metadata.title: Robot SF 0.0.8 social-navigation benchmark dataset (14 planners, 48 scenarios, 30 seeds)
metadata.description: Benchmark-data snapshot for Robot SF covering 14 planner arms, 48 social-navigation scenarios, and 30 seeds at horizon 600 with a 0.1-second simulation step and differential-drive kinematics (20,160 expected episode identities). The archive preserves raw episode evidence, existing metrics and the Social Navigation Quality Index (SNQI) v1, newly recorded robot-attributable pedestrian-force metrics, and the fully declared SNQI v2 specification and weight-family report. Robot force is a simulator-model quantity, not measured human discomfort. Both indices are advisory benchmark aggregates and do not rank deployment fitness.
